cues.en: Now the question is when we can use the insertion sort and when we need to avoid it.
So when we have insufficient memory, which means that memory is a concern, in this case we can use
And this was the case in case of the selection sort as well.
But here when we have the continuous inflow of numbers and we want to keep them sorted, in this case
it's recommended to use the insertion sort.
And the implementation also is easy.
And when the time is concerned, which means that you need efficient solution in terms of time complexity.
In this case you need to avoid insertion sort, because insertion sort in the worst case takes o n squared
time complexity, which is not efficient.
So hopefully everything is clear about insertion sort.
